function target(value: word) returns (word) {
    let renamed = value;
    let closure = lam (arg: word) { return renamed + arg; };
    match (renamed) {
        case pattern {
            assembly { pattern := add(pattern, renamed) }
            return closure(pattern) + value;
        }
    }
}
